title: Why Do Balloons Stick to Hair?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Balloons Stick to Hair.
The balloon and hair pull toward each other.
Let me show you that in 3D.
That is static electricity, not magic.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Then the charges slowly sneak away.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Rub a balloon. Charges move.
The pictures today are a new bubble world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do balloons stick to hair.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
